abstract: In the world's largest series of patients with intersex treated by laparoscopy, authors from Sao Paulo found that this technique allowed easy identification and removal of gonads. They also found that other organs could be removed and genitoplasty performed. OBJECTIVE: To present possibly the largest series of the use of laparoscopy for treating intersex patients. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Fifty intersex patients (34 with male and two with female pseudohermaphroditism, nine with gonadal dysgenesis, four with true hermaphroditism, and one with complex hypospadias), aged 0.5-46 years (mean 18.3), underwent laparoscopy to remove gonads and/or ductal structures incompatible with the social gender, or for gonadal tumour or a potential risk for malignancy. When necessary, genitoplasty was performed concomitantly. RESULTS: At the laparoscopic evaluation, 10 gonads of six patients were absent, while four were identified as 'vanishing'; 72 gonads (46 dysgenetic, 17 normal testes, one normal ovary, one ovotestis, seven gonadoblastomas or dysgerminomas) were removed; two ovotestes were replaced in the scrotum after removing the ovarian segment, as was one normal testis. Twelve patients with a urogenital sinus had its vaginal component removed, 11 including a hysterectomy. Three of these patients had a combined perineal approach to complete its removal, together with masculinizing genitoplasty. There were no intraoperative complications or conversions; two patients had complications after surgery. CONCLUSIONS: Laparoscopy allows the straightforward identification and removal of gonads. All abnormal ductal structures must be removed, as this increases the chance of resecting unidentified gonads. Removing the uterus and vaginal component of the urogenital sinus in patients with male social sex is feasible, with low morbidity. Genitoplasty, according to the social sex, can be performed in the same procedure.
abstract_ja:
目的：間性患者に対する腹腔鏡手術の、おそらく最大規模のシリーズを提示すること。
患者と方法：社会的性と適合しない生殖腺や管状構造の除去、または性腺腫瘍や悪性化のリスクのために腹腔鏡手術を受けた間性患者50例（年齢0.5〜46歳、平均18.3歳）。必要に応じて同時に性器形成術を行った。
結果：腹腔鏡での評価時、6例で10個の性腺が欠如しており、4個は「消失性」と判定された。72個の性腺（異形成性46個、正常精巣17個、正常卵巣1個、卵精巣1個、性腺芽腫またはディスジャーミノーマ7個）を摘出した。2個の卵精巣は卵巣部分を除去した後に陰嚢内へ戻し、正常精巣1個も同様に戻した。尿生殖洞の膣成分を12例で除去し、そのうち11例で子宮摘出を行った。このうち3例では、会陰部からの併用アプローチで除去を完了し、男性化性器形成術を併施した。術中合併症や術式変更はなく、術後合併症は2例に認められた。
結論：腹腔鏡により性腺を明確に同定し摘出できる。異常な管状構造はすべて除去すべきであり、これにより未同定の性腺を切除する可能性が高まる。社会的性が男性の患者において子宮と尿生殖洞の膣成分を除去することは実施可能で、罹患率も低い。性器形成術は社会的性に応じて同一手術中に行うことができる。
